summary: Confirm and fix staged-review installer findings SR-058–066: resilient mirrored ESP mount and fstab rewrite (nex-sync-esp + nofail timeout), repair installer-hostname render harness with real one/two/three-disk seed assertions, text Disk preselection, root-md-only mdadm.conf, heredoc syntax checks, GUI Use-column clicks, and multi-disk recheck wipe coverage. API impact: none.

guide.reason: docs/guide/install-nex-core.md already describes Use-column ticks, lone-disk preselection for both installers, and that the per-disk EFI mount must not hold up boot. This change makes the text installer and ESP tooling match that wording; no new operator step.

api.reason: Installer-local late-install and wizard handoff only. No Controller or Core API contract changes; system-disk replace already had a surviving-ESP fallback (BUG-0485).

roadmap.reason: Defect fixes within the existing mirrored-installer slice; no milestone status change.

state.reason: ESP fstab UUID, mdadm.conf and nex-sync-esp live on the installed host; a fresh Controller does not own them. Recovered by reading the host after install or replace.
state.record: /etc/fstab /boot/efi line, /etc/mdadm/mdadm.conf, /usr/local/sbin/nex-sync-esp and the APT Post-Invoke hook on the installed host.

verification.method: Confirmed each finding against source before fixing. python3 tests/integration/installer-hostname.py (compile + one/two/three-disk render). python3 tests/integration/installer-handoff.py (BUG-0413 + new two-disk wipe). bash installer/check.sh (heredoc sh -n, fstab sed fixture, root-md gate, text preselect assert). Other installer-*.py smoke that need no ISO. Booted host with ESP-owning disk detached and live GUI --mirror lab remain outstanding.
